blocks.title: Meta Ads That Go Beyond Boosted Posts
paragraphs: Hitting the boost button on a Facebook post is not a Meta Ads strategy. Real Meta advertising is a sophisticated, data-driven discipline that combines audience psychology, creative excellence, funnel strategy, and continuous optimization to deliver measurable business results.

Meta's advertising platform — covering Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and the Audience Network — gives businesses access to one of the most powerful targeting engines ever built. With the ability to reach people by demographics, interests, behaviors, location, and life events, Meta Ads allow you to put your business directly in front of the people most likely to become your customers.

True Line's Meta Ads specialists build and manage campaigns that do far more than generate impressions. We build full-funnel strategies that take your audience from awareness to consideration to conversion — with creative that stops the scroll and targeting that puts it in front of the right people every time.

blocks.title: Our Full-Funnel Meta Ads Approach
blocks.lead: We don't just run ads — we build a complete customer acquisition funnel.

items.title: Top of Funnel — Awareness
items.text: Reaching new, cold audiences who don't yet know your brand. We use broad interest targeting, lookalike audiences, and engaging video or image content to introduce your business to the right people.

items.title: Middle of Funnel — Consideration
items.text: Nurturing people who have shown interest — website visitors, video viewers, and social engagers. We serve them more detailed content, testimonials, and offers to build trust and move them closer to a decision.

items.title: Bottom of Funnel — Conversion
items.text: Targeting warm, high-intent audiences who are ready to act. Retargeting campaigns with strong calls to action, limited-time offers, and social proof to convert interest into customers.

items.title: Retention — Loyalty & Repeat Business
items.text: Re-engaging existing customers with new offers, product launches, and loyalty campaigns to drive repeat purchases and lifetime value.

items.q: How is Meta Ads different from boosting posts?
items.a: Boosting posts is a basic, limited form of promotion. Meta Ads through Ads Manager gives access to full campaign objectives, precise audience targeting, proper conversion tracking, A/B testing, and detailed analytics — delivering far superior results at comparable or lower cost.

items.q: How much should I spend on Meta Ads?
items.a: Budget depends on your goals, industry, and audience size. Most UAE businesses see strong results starting from AED 3,000–5,000 per month in ad spend. We help you determine the right budget and scale it as results improve.

items.q: How long before I see results?
items.a: Lead and conversion campaigns typically show early results within the first 2–4 weeks. For full optimization, allow 60–90 days as Meta's algorithm learns and campaigns are refined.

items.q: Do you create the ad creatives?
items.a: Yes — our in-house creative team produces all ad visuals, videos, and copy as part of our management service.

items.q: Can you manage both Facebook and Instagram together?
items.a: Yes — Meta Ads Manager manages both platforms simultaneously. We optimize placements across Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and the Audience Network within every campaign.

items.q: Can you take over existing campaigns?
items.a: Absolutely. We audit your existing account, identify performance issues, and take over full management — typically improving results significantly from the first month.
